marks.gloss_en: the pair's wager: whoever goes and provokes Hillel will take four hundred zuz
Hillel, asked why the eyes of the Tarmodians are bleary: because they live among the sands
Hillel, asked why the feet of the Africans are wide: because they live among the marshes
the provoker: if you are he, may there not be many like you in Israel -- because I lost four hundred zuz through you
Reish Lakish: 'faith' (Isa 33:6) -- that is the order of Zeraim

Rava: when a person is brought to judgment they say to him: did you deal in faith? did you fix times for Torah? did you engage in procreation? did you await salvation? did you dispute in wisdom? did you understand one thing from another?
the school of R' Yishmael: a person may mix a kav of chomton into a kor of grain, and need not be concerned
ומה ישראל שנקראו בנים למקום, ומתוך אהבה שאהבם קרא להם בני בכורי ישראל (Ex 4:22), כתיב עליהם והזר הקרב יומת -- גר הקל שבא במקלו ובתרמילו, על אחת כמה וכמה
Hillel: is a king appointed unless he knows the protocols of royalty? go learn the protocols of royalty
כלום ראוי אני להיות כהן גדול? והלא כתיב בתורה והזר הקרב יומת
the convert, before Shammai: am I at all fit to be High Priest? [I am not]
asked to convert him on condition he be taught the whole Torah while standing on one foot, Shammai pushed him away with the builder's cubit in his hand
asked for whom the garments of Ex 28:4 are, they told him: for the High Priest
Rabba bar Rav Huna: any person who has Torah but no fear of Heaven is like a treasurer to whom they gave the inner keys but not the outer keys -- by what will he enter?
לאו עלי דידי קא סמכת? דעל פה נמי סמוך עלי -- you relied on me for the letters; rely on me for the Oral [Torah] too
Shammai, asked how many Torahs 'you' have: two, the Written Torah and the Oral Torah
